lines.en: I knock on Miku’s door and wait for her to answer, though I wouldn’t be surprised if she decides not to tonight.
The two of us haven’t really spent much time together ever since the...occurrence at the beach house, and I’m sure she’s feeling a little strange about it.
I know I would be in her position.
Thankfully, I’ve never had the misfortune of being in the position of a [teenage]girl and have much more experience either on top of or beneath them.
But I digress.
The volume of Miku's TV inside of the room is turned down, the same way it has been several times before when I’ve visited this place.
So, the chances are she’s either about to invite me in-
Or peer through the door, see that it’s me, and then pretend to be asleep.
I knock again to let her know I’m onto her.
: Y-Yeah?
She bites immediately.
: Hey. Are you free tonight?
: Um...yeah.
: You wanna like...go out for a walk or somethin’?
: I think I’d prefer to hang out in there.
: You sure? It’s...supposed to be really nice out right now!
: It’s freezing. I was literally just outside.
: Yeah yeah but like, what if it...isn’t anymore?!
: Just let me in, Miku.
: Gaaaaah...fine! But only cause I feel bad for makin’ ya wait out in the hallway and stuff...
: Uhh...
: So...how about that weather?
: Is that just going to be your go-to topic for avoiding awkward conversation tonight or are you suddenly interested in becoming a meteorologist?
: The heck do meteors have to do with the weather?
: That’s-
: Actually, never mind.
: Is there something you want to talk about?
: Well since we’re already on the topic of meteors-
: Miku.
: Do we really have to talk about the thing that happened or can we just kinda...pretend it never did?
: Pretending it never happened means there will be less of a chance for it to happen again, so I’d like to avoid that if at all possible.
: That’s...kinda why I think we should avoid it. I can’t be thinkin’ about that kinda stuff with you, Sensei.
: Why not?
: Cause you’re my friggin’ teacher, my soccer coach, and the guy my best friend obviously has the hots for!
: That’s a triple whammy, Sensei! I’ve gotta put myself on the bench for this one!
: Just take a seat on my lap instead. You’ve proven on two occasions now that you like it there.
: Come on...
: I know I don’t act serious all that often cause like...I’m not good at actin’ like that...but I’m really trying right now.
: There are some things you just shouldn’t do and I’m pretty sure that bumpin’ uglies with a triple whammy is one of ‘em.
: And I already have a hard enough time with feelin’ all weird around you, so hearin’ stuff about sittin’ on your lap makes it like a billion times harder.
: You feel weird because you like me, Miku.
: Well, yeah! That much should be obvious after the beach!
: And even before that!
: I started feelin’ that way about you a while ago...but it’s not like I ever saw myself hidin’ under the covers with you!
: I didn’t even know you were gonna be sleepin’ in that bed! The heck were ya thinkin’ gettin' all up in my space like that?!
: That was actually Makoto’s idea, so we can probably just blame her for this entire ordeal.
: Why the heck would Makoto let ya sleep next to me?!
: Because I promised to keep my hands to myself.
: Which I actually did until...you know.
: Aaaahhhh! Whose idea was it to invent hormones anyway?! They just make everythin’ harder!
: I don’t know how many times you want me to say it, but I really don’t mind doing things like that with you.
: Well yeah. Ya made that pretty obvious the first time you started puttin’ your hands where they don’t belong.
: But I already told you, the two of us can’t do stuff like that.
: Sure we can. Especially since you’re already aware that you actually like me and that it’s not entirely hormones.
: I know I friggin’ like you, Sensei. Stop makin’ me say it.
: Why?
: Because it just friggin’ reminds me of how long my best friend has liked you compared to me.
: How long has Makoto liked me, Miku?
: I don’t know! Months? Years?
: But you two have only been my students for a few months, haven’t you?
: Course not! If that’s true then how come-
: Wait, what the heck?
: Yeah. It’s only been a few months.
: Why’s it feel like so much longer?
It appears we are now two-for-two.
First, Makoto started to catch on to how strange the flow of time has gotten with three semesters of memories packed into one-
And now Miku is on that same exact train.
Pretty soon, everyone will be on board and the world will collapse.
Or at least that’s what I imagine Maya would say.
But this simply can’t go on forever.
Within a matter of time, someone is going to start piecing it together. And once they do, I’ll be able to talk about it without sounding like I’m absolutely insane.
For example, watch this-
: Miku, what if I told you that the reason it feels like it’s been longer is because we’re stuck in a time loop?
: A time what now? Have you been drinkin’ or something?
See?
No one will believe me.
Sometimes, you need to see the end of the world to accept that not everything is as it seems.
And I’m sure that same thing will apply to Miku, Makoto, and anyone else who begins to piece it all together.
Just like all of the girls I know, Kumon-mi is one big puzzle.
So big that everyone has to work together to even fathom the chance of ever finishing it.
But that’s enough thinking for now.
There are more important things currently at stake.
: Why does it matter what Makoto wants if it directly contradicts what you want?
: It matters cause Makoto is my best friend and wants to do all sorts of cute girly stuff with you like...takin’ out a mortgage or adopting a parrot.
: You have a strange idea of what constitutes “girly.”
: I’m a friggin’ tomboy, Sensei. Go talk to Ami if ya want to know about girly stuff.
: Fact is, Makoto wants to do stuff with you and my mind keeps gettin’ wrapped around on stuff I want you to do to me.
: So...you like me, but you’re more interested in the physical aspect of it rather than something like growing old together and buying a house?
: Kinda, yeah.
: This is the actual best news I’ve ever received.
: That’s not good news at all! I don’t know the first thing about that kinda stuff!
: I mean...you definitely know at least something now.
: You’re really not makin’ this any easier on me, Sensei.
: Good. It’s not supposed to be easy.
: It’s good that you care so much about something that could hurt someone close to you.
: But it’s not good how you’re giving up what you want in favor of that.
: I’m sure I don’t have to say this, but there are a lot more than just two people vying for my affection right now.
: You’ve got half the friggin’ class ready to take off their skirts for ya.
: And I’m sure they’ll all come off in due time.
: I’m not looking to take out a mortgage with Makoto or...adopt a bird or whatever it was you said.
: I just want to spend time with all of you and, if we both happen to want to do a little extra with that time, I have no issues with it whatsoever.
: But...I just keep thinkin’ of how all those girls would feel if they found out.
: How would you feel if you found out I was doing things with the other girls?
: Weird.
: Don’t you already feel weird, though?
: I always feel weird when you’re around.
: Because you like me.
: Stop it with all that “like” business! I friggin’ know!
: So what then? Are you just going to avoid how you feel forever?
: No...I’ll just...wait until I feel different or somethin’.
: I doubt that’s going to happen any time soon.
: Same here...but if Makoto ever finds out that I’m feelin’ stuff for the same guy she is...it’ll be a whole thing.
: And if she doesn’t find out?
: Then I can just...secretly feel bad, I guess.
: Great. Do that.
: I’m no genius but that really doesn’t sound like a good idea.
: It’s better to suffer in silence than it is to suffer in front of spectators.
: You’re already suffering. And that’s only going to get worse with time.
: So the best course of action would be to risk the chance of greater suffering in exchange for the guarantee of no suffering now, wouldn’t it?
: I don’t know...that’s too many steps for me to follow.
: I just don’t like hidin’ stuff from my friends. That’s all.
: You hide things all the time, don’t you?
: Huh?
: What are ya talkin’ about?
: I mean that I still don’t know anything about you.
: Or why you react in certain ways to certain things.
: Telling you...wouldn’t help at all...
: And I understand that.
: I guess what I’m saying is that if you’re already hiding things from people, one or two more won’t hurt.
: Sensei...you’re sayin’ all this stuff that I can’t really keep up with...
: I’m just channeling my skills in negotiation to help you cope with your feelings.
: And also get your clothes off in the process.
: But why me if there are a bunch of other girls who’d take ‘em off without all the extra steps?
: Seems like you’re workin’ hard but not smart when ya do it like that.
: Who knows? Maybe I just like tomboys?
: You sure you don’t just like boys in general if you’re comin’ onto someone like me?
: You are very much not a boy, Miku. I have confirmed that.
: My chest begs to differ.
: How about I be the judge of that?
: Not sure how I feel about ya invitin’ some little boy into the room to compare us side by side...
: No invitations necessary. Just give in to my expert negotiation skills and take your shirt off.
: Wow...uhh...didn’t think you’d be that direct...
: You were literally grinding up against me while I was asleep the other night. What I’m doing is significantly less direct than that.
: We’re still both in the wrong, though.
: Well...at least we know we're in the wrong.
: Exactly. So what’s the harm in doing one more little thing?
: It’s not like I’m asking you to have sex or something.
: Unless...
: I don’t wanna have friggin’ sex, Sensei. The only position I know is the backwards cowboy.
: How did we come back to that?
: If I...do take off my shirt, though...what are you going to do?
: Cause I’ll feel weird if you just like...stand there and be all like, “Wow, Miku. You do look like a boy after all,” or somethin’.
: Well since you kicked me out the last time I tried touching you in here, there’s not really anything else I can do.
: I don’t mind if you touch me...just...not down below.
: That’s still a little too much...
: So you're fine with hiding this from Makoto after all?
: I’m...tryin’ not to think of Makoto right now...
: To...put myself first or whatever you said...
: So...we’re doing this?
: I’m not really doin’ anything. But if you wanna like...you know...judge them or something like you said...
An awkward silence fills the room as I come to terms with the fact that I just convinced a nervous girl to strip for me despite her great hesitation.
The moment does not last long.
: Get out! Right now!
: Wait, hold on. I really didn’t do any-
: I SAID GET OUT!
: MMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMM!!!!! MA...KOTO!!!!!!!!!
I leave the room and go home to my normal life and normal [niece].
I try to jerk off when I get there but I can’t.
I fall asleep before eating.
I wake up in the middle of the night with a stomach ache and an apology text message from Makoto.
Life goes on.
Miku’sssssssssssssssssssssssssssssss affection dismay has increased to [[ERROR]!
There are more important things to be done right now.
: Hah...Sensei...
: Your hands are...really cold...
: I told you it was freezing outside, didn’t I?
: Yeah but...you’ve been inside for a while now...
: Why are they...like that?
: Not sure. Maybe because all of the blood in my body has rushed somewhere else?
: Hah...wh...what?...What does that...even mean?...
: Don’t worry about it.
: Are you...uhh...havin’ a good time back there?...
: Are you having a good time up there?
: I feel...really hot...
: Then take your shorts off as well.
: No...I told ya I'm...not ready for that...
: Even this is like...a little too...
: Ngh!~
I pinch one of Miku’s nipples, which have already gotten hard from a mixture of arousal and my apparently cold hands, and send a jolt through her body.
I can’t see them, but I can feel her legs beginning to shake as she leans up against me to maintain her balance.
: H-Hey! Those are...sensitive!
: I’ve heard that small ones like yours are even more sensitive.
: Oh...great! One more way to...kick me while I’m down!
: I like you like this, Miku. You wouldn’t be the same if you were any larger.
: I knew it! You...really do like boys!
: That is absolutely not a thing you should be saying to a man as he’s fondling you.
: Ahh...hah! Yeah! I know that! Just...feelin’...a little dizzy...and...
: Can’t...think straight...
: Don’t think at all, then. Just let me do my thing.
: Your thing is...friggin’ weird, Sensei...
: How’s this...doin’ anything at all for you?...
: Honestly? It’s not.
: But it’s fun seeing you act like this and is one more step on the way to getting you to suck my-
: Ah! Io! You told me you had the other end!
: I thought I did! I-
: Ah! Sir Meowington the Fourth!
: AAAAAAHHH! I knew we should have asked for help if we were gonna move this friggin' dresser!
: Oi! What's goin' on over there?!
: We're trying to kill a dragon and your late night furniture moving is too loud!
: Molly, shh! You can’t be yelling like that this late at night!
: How is this my fault when they're the ones being loud this time?!
: It’s okay.
: Everything is fine.
: It’s just girls being girls.
I have nightvision.
Miku drops to her knees and covers her mouth with her hands, something I imagine she’s practiced in the event of things like this ever happening in her bedroom.
And instead of doing anything to help, I find myself lost in thought.
How hard must it be to practice things like this? And how unfortunate do you have to be in order to have to do that?
How much willpower does it take to uphold that practice when all else except the pain you have experienced has been drained from your mind?
: Miku!
And who is here?
: Oh, Makoto. Good timing.
: What did you do to her?
: Miku and I were just hanging out when-
